sloka: राजा वा राजमात्रो वा मृगयामटते वने ।अन्यद्वा श्वापदं किञ्चित् सौमित्रे ज्ञातुमर्हसि ॥ २.९६.९॥
transliteration: rājā vā rājamātro vā mṛgayāmaṭate vane ।anyadvā śvāpadaṁ kiñcit saumitre jñātumarhasi ॥ 2.96.9॥

translations.english: O Lakshmana, do ascertain if any king or prince has come for hunting or whether any ferocious animal has entered this forest, shouldn't you?
